summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) including cleanup helpers, media/streaming test suites, batch download tests, and capturing meaningful load test baselines against staging with BYO-IPFS (Pinata) support.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed: deleteAccountViaPage helper wired into 10 specs, media/streaming and batch download E2E suites created (16 new tests), staging journey timing and 200-client sustained load baselines captured. BYO Pinata pin latency confirmed (p50=718ms) but register-cid/ipns-publish return 400s on staging — tracked as a todo.

repo: Playwright config (tests/web-e2e/playwright.config.ts) did not respect BASE_URL env var for overriding baseURL — required explicit env check and conditional webServer disabling to target staging
Staging Web3Auth SDK initialization takes ~22.7s; wallet button timeout of 20s in journey-timing.spec.ts was too short for staging environments
Cleanup helper deleteAccountViaPage derived API URL from localhost:3000 hardcode — needed to derive from page URL to work on staging
vitest in tests/load/ does not auto-load .env files — must source manually via shell before running tests

Running two load test suites simultaneously against the same staging instance causes them to compete and saturate the API, producing misleading throttle failures — bypass header was working correctly all along
Pinata free tier is exhausted quickly under load testing; 100% pin failure after running multiple capacity ceiling tests against a free account
BYO register-cid and ipns-publish endpoints return 400 on staging when using Pinata provider — likely test accounts not configured in BYO mode or endpoint expects different params
The staging API throttle bypass guard works correctly when tested via curl or direct Node fetch; the issue was concurrent test load exhausting staging, not missing headers

code.finding: deleteAccountViaPage used two separate page.evaluate calls; merged into one. API URL was hardcoded to localhost:3000; now derives from page URL to support staging.

Dynamic imports for fs/path were inside test body; moved to top-level. Used existsSync before unlink (TOCTOU); replaced with try/catch. Corrupt file fixture was untracked and leaked between tests; now tracked for cleanup.
Inline account deletion logic duplicated deleteAccountViaPage from cleanup-helpers.ts; replaced with shared helper.
baseURL was hardcoded; now reads BASE_URL env var with localhost fallback. webServer block conditionally skipped when BASE_URL points to non-localhost.
No dotenv support in vitest config; .env must be sourced in shell before running tests since dotenv package is not available in this workspace.
200-client baseline: 11,174 total ops, 0.17% error rate, uploadFile p50=8.1s p95=11.6s, createFolder p50=6.5s p95=11.9s, deleteItem p50=3.2s p95=5.2s over 5 minutes.

workflow: When running multiple load test suites against a shared staging environment, always run them serially to avoid false throttle failures
Playwright MCP browser tool is useful for diagnosing blank page failures — navigate to staging, check console messages, and evaluate DOM before assuming a test timeout is a code issue
Cherry-picking commits from parallel worktree agents to the phase branch requires careful conflict resolution on STATE.md; use the worktree's version since it has the most recent plan state
classifyHandoffIfNeeded errors from Claude Code Task() are runtime bugs, not agent failures — spot-check SUMMARY.md and git commits to determine actual success
Git lock files from failed worktree agents must be cleaned up before retrying; use git worktree remove --force followed by manual .git/worktrees cleanup

friction: Wave 1 agents ran in separate worktrees; cherry-picking commits to the phase branch caused STATE.md conflicts on every agent merge
34-03 agent hit a git lock from the 34-02 worktree — had to force-remove stale worktree before retrying
Playwright BASE_URL override didn't work because playwright.config.ts ignored it — wasted multiple test runs debugging a blank staging page before finding the root cause
Running BYO capacity ceiling and sustained load tests simultaneously caused both to fail with throttle errors, misleading investigation toward a code bug that didn't exist
vitest doesn't auto-load .env files; required manual shell sourcing workaround since dotenv isn't in the load test workspace
Pinata free tier quota was exhausted during BYO capacity ceiling tests, making all pin operations fail and preventing meaningful BYO baselines
1Password SSH signing failed during todo commit, requiring a fallback commit approach
Background load test process exceeded the 10-minute bash timeout for the browser load test
34-04 SUMMARY.md had to be updated three times: initial partial, post-journey-timing, and post-load-test
open_items: BYO register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging with Pinata provider — tracked in .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-29-debug-byo-ipfs-register-cid-400-errors-on-staging.md
New E2E specs (streaming-playback, media-preview) use binary stub fixtures that need a live environment run to confirm they trigger correct AES-CTR/GCM code paths
BYO capacity ceiling baselines are incomplete — Pinata free tier was exhausted; need a paid account or clean free account to capture real BYO pin throughput at 50-1000 client tiers
SDK load test harness createTestAccount does not throttle-batch account creation; running 200+ clients creates a burst that relies entirely on the bypass header being present
Browser load test baselines (5 clients, 305/395 ops) show C4/C5 context exhaustion under contention — Playwright browser-based load testing doesn't scale beyond ~3 concurrent sessions reliably
